newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner, Turner Broadcasting at a glance.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner, Turner Broadcasting at a glance.

text.p: The following is a brief description of assets owned by Time Warner Inc. and Turner Broadcasting System Inc. :
Warner Brothers Pictures, responsible for films such as "Outbreak," "Batman Forever," "Bridges of Madison County," "Ace Ventura," Twister."
Warner Brothers Television, responsible for programs such as "ER," "Friends" and "Murphy Brown"
Warner Bros. Records, representing stars such as Madonna, Seal, R.E.M., Alanis Morissette and Tom Petty.
Atlantic Group, representing artists such as Collective Soul, Hootie and the Blowfish and Phil Collins.
Elektra Entertainment Group representing artists such as Natalie Merchant, AC/DC, Metallica and Jackson Browne.
Warner Music International, representing Enya, Cher and Pretenders.
Home Box Office cable TV service.
Time Inc. Magazines, including Time, Fortune, Life, Sports Illustrated, Money and People.
Six Flags Theme Parks (Time Warner owns 49 percent stake)
Atlanta Braves baseball and Atlanta Hawks hockey teams
